nodes.label: Ethics and regulation
nodes.question: Why is it important to engage young people in co-designing technologies aimed at enhancing societal participation?
nodes.answer: Engaging young people in co-designing technologies is important because it allows them to voice their perspectives and ensures that the technologies address their real needs, potentially lowering barriers to their participation.

nodes.label: Ethics and regulation
nodes.question: Why is it important to engage young people in the design of technologies aimed at societal participation?
nodes.answer: Engaging young people in the design of technologies allows them to voice their perspectives and ensures that the technologies address their real needs and preferences.

nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: Why is it important to engage young people in the design of technologies that support societal participation?
nodes.answer: Engaging young people in design allows them to voice their perspectives, ensures the technologies address real needs, and can increase their interest in societal matters in the future.
